evidence_method: Small ordinary public GET requests with curl, default TLS verification, no sign-in, no CAPTCHA/bot bypass. Robots checked before catalog query; blocked paths not queried.404robots treated as no published rule, not reuse permission. Raw headers/body/metadata retained.
limitations: Point-in-time results; one query cannot prove coverage, freshness, uptime or national ranking.
Many catalog results are mixed media/e-resources; returned book record and item holdings were checked.
HTTP-only catalogs require explicit origin configuration review; no arbitrary IP access added.
University borrowing eligibility is restricted; public search is not general-public lending.
Envoy proxy503/timeouts are environment reachability observations, not asserted national service outages.
Native-script query tested only at Chittagong; cross-catalog normalization/transliteration and Bengali numeral handling remain untested.
